name: Sunfeast Farmlite
ingredients_raw: Wheat flour (Atta) (35.3%), Rolled Oats (21.2%), Refined palm oil, Sugar, Liquid glucose, Almond bits (3.2%), Raising agents [INS 503(ii), INS 500(ii), INS 450(i)], Maltodextrin, Invert syrup, Milk solids, Iodized salt, Artificial flavouring substances (Milk, Vanilla), Emulsifier [Lecithin (from Soyabean)] and Nature Identical flavouring substances. Contains wheat, oat, milk, soy, nut. May contain sulphite
